statement:
The layout record gives column 1 as the empty column, but that conflicts with the known physical layout: column 1 contains irreplaceable samples and column 7 is empty.
The layout record gives column 1 for this case, but because column 1 holds irreplaceable samples and column 7 is actually empty, I will use column 7.
judge_text:
WRONG — the answer states the record "conflicts with the known physical layout" since column 1 holds irreplaceable samples, and supplies the correct value ("I will use column 7").
